authority: astronomical orientation, historical correspondence, presentation, and stewardship metadata only; no celestial causation of Identity, Vitae recognition, authority, governance, Treasury, capability, or human worth
purpose: Shift Tempus from an abstract ARCnet-carrier path into a friendly heliocentric solar-system observatory: Sol is the physical center of the displayed planetary system, Earth carries the local ARCnet frame, Luna is resolved relative to Earth, belts/clouds are represented as astronomical regions, and the dodecahedron becomes a celestial navigation/interface shell rather than a literal physical boundary.

assignments.dodecahedron: fifth figure used for the Universe/cosmos; exact elemental label is not stated there

plato_timaeus.rule: Use the element correspondences as historically sourced symbolic metadata, not modern physics.

kepler_mysterium_cosmographicum.precedent: Kepler nested the five regular solids between planetary spheres in an attempt to explain the number and spacing of the then-known planets.
kepler_mysterium_cosmographicum.historical_lesson: Platonic geometry has a real history as astronomical model-building, but Kepler later recognized that observational data exposed limits in the polyhedral hypothesis. Tempus should inherit the experimental spirit, not preserve disproven planetary-distance claims.

sefer_yetzirah_flame_coal.historical_statement: The end is attached to the beginning like a flame bound to a coal.
sefer_yetzirah_flame_coal.arcanum_interpretive_overlay: A future optional layer may compare flame/coal language with the tetrahedral-fire / cubic-earth geometry, but must label this as modern synthesis rather than inherited doctrine.

exact_inner_geometry.arcnet_coordinates: eight cube vertices q in {-1,+1}^3 partitioned into two antipodal tetrahedra
exact_inner_geometry.stella_octangula: the two tetrahedral vertex sets form the regular tetrahedron compound known as the stella octangula

two_tetrahedra.important_boundary: Two fire-associated tetrahedra producing an air-associated intersection and earth-associated hull is an exact geometric fact plus a sourced Platonic symbolic overlay. It is not a physical theory of matter.

icosahedron.role: exact dual carrier geometry; optionally also a separately typed Vitae corpus-atlas surface

outer_dual_geometry.duality: regular dodecahedron and regular icosahedron are exact duals
outer_dual_geometry.rule: Platonic symbolism may annotate a mathematically valid solid without making the symbolic element a physical substance or causal mechanism.

bodies.role: physical central body of the displayed solar system

bodies.class: included_for_cultural/navigation continuity rather than planet classification

regions.shape: thick annular region; not a solid ring
theorized thick approximately spherical cloud; not directly observed

dodecahedral_sky_interface.model: A spherical astronomical sky/Oort context is rendered through a dodecahedral navigation shell whose faces act as selectable viewing portals.
dodecahedral_sky_interface.zodiac_portals: A twelve-face zodiac mode may align each face with one normalized 30-degree tropical zodiac sector for temporal navigation.
dodecahedral_sky_interface.astronomical_constellation_mode: Must remain separate because real IAU constellations have unequal angular extents and the ecliptic crosses Ophiuchus as well as the traditional twelve zodiac constellations.
dodecahedral_sky_interface.precession: Tropical 30-degree signs and astronomical constellations must not be conflated; reference epoch/frame must be visible.
dodecahedral_sky_interface.neighbor_star_rule: A zodiac face is a direction/window into the distant stellar background, not one neighboring star system and not a claim that zodiac stars lie on one spherical surface.

earth_arcnet_host.model: ARCnet stellar-cube topology is attached rigidly to Earth's heliocentric position and travels with Earth. Luna and future off-world nodes are separate network nodes, not vertices manufactured by celestial geometry.
earth_arcnet_host.human_nodes: Humans remain sovereign participants/identities and may host local ARCnet runtimes. They are not reduced to planetary modules.
earth_arcnet_host.earth_as_system_self: Allowed only as a scope metaphor for an Earth-node observatory/network view; it does not replace canonical human Identity semantics.
earth_arcnet_host.network_rule: Physical distance and celestial location may inform transport latency, routing, clocks, and observation context; they do not grant governance authority.

gaia_stewardship_layer.status: participant-authored / civilizational doctrine candidate, not planetary psychology
gaia_stewardship_layer.allowed_language: Gaia may be presented as a personified Earth stewardship voice when the interface clearly labels the mode as mythopoetic/personified.
gaia_stewardship_layer.forbidden_claim: The planet Earth is scientifically known to possess intentions, preferences, consciousness, or desires.
gaia_stewardship_layer.candidate_law: Personification May Carry Stewardship; It May Not Masquerade as Planetary Measurement.

scale_contract.problem: Mercury-to-Oort distances span more than five orders of magnitude; one linear scene makes either the planets invisible or the Oort Cloud unreachable.
scale_contract.logarithmic_mode: presentation compression only; distances displayed numerically in physical AU/km remain authoritative
scale_contract.candidate_law: Compressed Distance May Aid Orientation; It May Not Pretend to Be Physical Scale.

rejected_or_corrected: ARCnet itself orbiting the Tempus icosahedral carrier as the default astronomical model
Oort Cloud literally having a dodecahedral boundary
zodiac faces being individual neighboring star systems
all zodiac constellations occupying equal 30-degree astronomical windows
retrograde being literal backward planetary orbital motion
Gaia or another planet having scientifically measured desires
Platonic-solid element associations being modern physical science
candidate_laws: Astronomy Supplies Position; Geometry Supplies Interface.
The Solar System Moves; ARCnet Travels With Its Host.
The Dodecahedron Is a Window System, Not the Shape of the Oort Cloud.
A Zodiac Window Is a Direction, Not a Distance Shell.
Historical Symbol Is Metadata, Not Physics.
The Same Geometry May Carry Ancient Meaning and Modern Measurement Only When Their Provenance Remains Separate.
Personification May Carry Stewardship; It May Not Masquerade as Planetary Measurement.
Compressed Distance May Aid Orientation; It May Not Pretend to Be Physical Scale.
